presentation.description:
HamMeter is a minimalist combat tracker and damage meter for Final Fantasy XIV, built with a strict focus on an easy-to-read layout! It reads encounter data from IINACT over Dalamud IPC.
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/NennMichSchinken/HamMeter/main/repo.json
